utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What’s still left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s left on the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep me posted if anything’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ve got the volunteer list organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll check my calendar and confirm the timing for after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I may be a bit foggy, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Oren. I can help with the repair drive too—just point me to the list and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll point you to the list and we can keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect you with the right folks if you want me to.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — if you can point me to Mara, that'd help. I think I missed the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — Mara’s the right person for the sign-up details. I’ll point you her way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can send you the repair drive details and sign-up info.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, send them over and I’ll keep an eye on who still needs supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send the details and sign-up info now, and thanks for keeping an eye on the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone tonight, so come by if you can. We could still use a few more hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the list and the sink tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, bring them by tonight and we’ll put those tools to work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just the broken coupler and the loose bracket. Once we know which one’s actually failing, we can grab the right parts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can take a look at the coupler or the bracket. Which one should we check first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is really moving along, and they could still use a few more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I can help keep things moving if someone shares the latest list and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Depends what you need. I can check the list and pick up whatever keeps the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I’m happy to help sort the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great. What’s still on the list, and about how much is left to cover?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like it’s on track, and Friday is still the day to drop off supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, so Friday is still set. What exactly needs to be fixed, and who should we bring the supplies to?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d keep it simple: we’re still on for Friday, and I’d ask around for the exact list of repairs and where the supplies should go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by tonight and help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, come by tonight. We could still use a few more hands and any supplies you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring any tools I have and see what else needs doing when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa said she has the repair list and drop-off spot ready, so I’m just waiting on those details before I meet up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, just waiting on the last details?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on. I just need the repair list and the drop-off spot to lock everything in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by tonight and help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Rey — come by tonight and we’ll get the repair drive wrapped up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What’s left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the furniture and that leaky sink, right? I can help with one of those.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can take one and keep track of the rest. Which one do you want me on?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for tonight, right? I just want to make sure before I plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it should still be on for tonight. I’m a little fuzzy on the details, though.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking: it’s still on for tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not fully comfortable saying it’s definitely on unless we’ve got the timing and enough people confirmed. I’d want one more check before we count on tonight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Understood. I still need the timing and headcount before I can count on tonight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, I’m still not ready to call it definite until we’ve got the timing and headcount locked in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along. Need anything from the hardware store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, actually. If you can grab some wood glue and a few assorted screws, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I’ll grab those and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Come by tonight if you can. We could use a few more hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo. I’ll come by and make sure everyone knows the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll spread the word and bring what supplies I can. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me exactly what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still gathering the exact list, but it’s the kind of thing where a few more hands really help. Come by tonight if you can, and I’ll make sure you know where you’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you at least tell me what the current priority is? I want to make sure I help with the right thing tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like Rosa and Vik have it covered, so I’m happy to help once the repair list and drop-off spot are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds right. I can bring my tools by once the list and drop-off spot are set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Exactly, once Rosa sends the list and Vik confirms the drop-off spot, I can help right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect you with the right folks for the repair drive. Who do you need me to reach out to next?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d keep it simple and check who still needs help. Friday’s still the day for dropping off supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check who still needs help and make sure Friday drop-off is covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is still moving along, and they could really use a few more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the repair list and point people to the furniture and sink.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After pickup still works for me, and I’ll check my calendar now so we can lock in the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that works for me too. I’ll keep the repair drive on the list and wait for your calendar check.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, I’ll check my calendar and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can send you the details and the sign-up info for the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — how much is needed, and can you send the details?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s whatever you can spare, and yes, I can send the details and sign-up info now.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
